I need to understand how listOverdueIssues and project stats are computed.

Carefully reviewing the substantial requirements.

OrganizationSettings will gain a `timeZone` field defaulting to "UTC". It will be stored and returned with every organization read. Invalid zones are rejected with a RangeError. A new helper in `src/lib/date.ts` will compute the local calendar date for an ISO timestamp in a given zone.

A new helper will compute the UTC instant at which a zone's local calendar day begins. `isOverdue` and `digestWindow` will accept an optional timezone parameter defaulting to "UTC". An issue is overdue once the workspace clock's calendar day containing its due date has ended; it remains current on that same day regardless of time.

Only open, unarchived issues with a due date can be overdue. This applies to `isOverdue`, the overdue job runner, and project stats counters.

The digest hour setting is now interpreted as an hour on the workspace clock. Digest windows end at the most recent local hour:00 at or before the current time.

Digest windows begin at the same local hour on the previous calendar day, so they can span 23 or 25 hours across DST transitions. Hours outside 0-23 still throw a RangeError.

The digest job collects only unread notifications created inside that window. Anything newer stays unread for the next digest.

Activity feed grouping now buckets events by local calendar date using the workspace timezone. Days appear newest first, and events within each day keep their original order.

/**
 * Brings `databasePath` up to date. Generated migrations win when they exist;
 * otherwise the embedded schema is pushed. Safe to run repeatedly — every
 * statement is `IF NOT EXISTS`.
 */
export async function runMigrations(
  databasePath: string = process.env.TASKFLOW_DB_PATH ?? DEFAULT_DB_PATH,
): Promise<void> {
  const absolute = resolve(process.cwd(), databasePath);
  mkdirSync(dirname(absolute), { recursive: true });

  const sqlite = new Database(absolute);
  sqlite.pragma("journal_mode = WAL");

  try {
    for (const statement of readMigrationStatements()) {
      sqlite.exec(statement);
    }
  } finally {
    sqlite.close();
  }
}

/** `pnpm db:migrate` runs this file directly; importing it must stay inert. */
if (process.argv[1]?.endsWith("migrate.ts") === true) {
  await runMigrations();
}

function readMigrationStatements(): readonly string[] {
  const dir = resolve(process.cwd(), MIGRATIONS_DIR);
  if (!existsSync(dir)) return SCHEMA_STATEMENTS;

  const files = readdirSync(dir)
    .filter((name) => name.endsWith(".sql"))
    .sort();

  if (files.length === 0) return SCHEMA_STATEMENTS;

  return files.flatMap((name) =>
    readFileSync(join(dir, name), "utf8")
      .split("--> statement-breakpoint")
      .map((chunk) => chunk.trim())
      .filter(Boolean),
  );
}
